title: Clinical laboratory: interior renovation of a leased medical-plaza suite — Trujillo Alto, zone X
description: We are opening a clinical laboratory in a leased suite in a medical plaza in Trujillo Alto. We will draw blood and run diagnostic tests on patient samples. Interior renovation only: new partition walls, a sink line and a sample-processing room; no exterior changes. Five employees, including licensed medical technologists.

existing_building.evidence: leased suite in a medical plaza

mustInclude.rationale: RULE_0762 (added 2026-10-16, verified): Ley 97-1962 Art. 1 bars establishing or operating a clinical laboratory without a license from the Secretario de Salud; Reg. 9508 (2023) Cap. II Arts. 8-9 set the initial application.

RULE_0763 (added 2026-10-16, verified): 42 U.S.C. 263a; 42 C.F.R. 493.3(a) — every non-exempt laboratory needs a CLIA certificate (Form CMS-116, filed with the PR state agency SARSP); Puerto Rico is not CLIA-exempt.
RULE_0096 / RULE_0029: licensed medical technologists -> Junta Examinadora professional licenses.
RULE_0644: interior work (new partition walls, sink line) reads as project_type renovation -> construction permit (Ley 161-2009).
RULE_0007: physical commercial premises -> Permiso Unico (Art. 8.4A, Ley 161-2009); Reg. 9508 Art. 9(b)-(c) also lists the use permit and Permiso Unico in the lab-license file.
RULE_0683: medical waste generated (blood draws, sharps) -> biomedical-waste generator ID; heuristic (missing biomedical_waste_types), so needs_more_information.
RULE_0651: new LLC -> Certificate of Organization (Departamento de Estado).
RULE_0020: employees -> CFSE workers' compensation policy.

mustNotInclude.rationale: RULE_0097 is heuristic (missing facility_license_category): DOC_HEALTH_PERMIT is the food-establishment sanitary permit and must never be REQUIRED for a laboratory that sells no food.
No alcohol: RULE_0013/0014/0015 need Q_ALCOHOL_SOLD / SERVED / MANUFACTURED; business-type alcohol rules exist only for Bar / Juice Bar.
FEMA zone X: RULE_0706/0707 need location.flood_zone.sfha / floodway, which zone X never sets.
Pin outside the official coastal zone (NOAA CZMA 'outside'): RULE_0708 needs location.czm.
Commercial district on urban land, no change of use: RULE_0709-0712 cannot fire.
No controlled substances stated: RULE_0734 needs Q_CONTROLLED_SUBSTANCES.

ordering.rationale: KB documents.json: DOC_CLINICAL_LAB_LICENSE depends on DOC_CLIA_CERTIFICATE (Reg. 9508 Art. 9(d) and Cap. III: a new laboratory must hold a CLIA registration certificate before the state license issues).
KB documents.json: DOC_CLINICAL_LAB_LICENSE depends on DOC_PERMISO_UNICO (Reg. 9508 Art. 9(b)-(c): use permit and Permiso Unico are part of the initial license file).
KB documents.json: DOC_PERMISO_UNICO depends on DOC_OGPE_CONSTRUCTION_PERMIT.

notes: Added 2026-10-16 by the scenario loop: first clinical-laboratory and first Trujillo Alto scenario. It found a KB gap, fixed in the same PR: the only state health card for a lab was DOC_HEALTH_PERMIT (the food sanitary permit, needs_more_information by design), and neither the Ley 97-1962 operating license nor the federal CLIA certificate existed. Added DOC_CLINICAL_LAB_LICENSE (RULE_0762) and DOC_CLIA_CERTIFICATE (RULE_0763), both verified against primary sources: Ley 97-1962 Arts. 1 y 3 (bvirtualogp.pr.gov), Departamento de Salud Reglamento Num. 9508 of 3 Oct 2023 (salud.pr.gov/CMS/DOWNLOAD/9063), 42 C.F.R. 493.3 and 493.5 (eCFR), and CMS Form CMS-116 with the CMS CLIA state-agency list. Not encoded, for expert review: (1) Reg. 9508 Art. 9(a) and Cap. III(c) also require a Certificado de Necesidad y Conveniencia (CNC, Ley 2 de 7 de noviembre de 1975) before a new lab is licensed; the KB has no CNC document and the CNC law's exemptions should be confirmed before it is added. (2) Reg. 9508 Art. 9(e) lists the biomedical-waste generator number as part of the license file, which argues for RULE_0683 being REQUIRED for a lab; it stays heuristic until the waste-stream fact is modeled. (3) A physician office running only waived tests also needs a CLIA Certificate of Waiver (42 C.F.R. 493.5(c)) and a Salud office-testing certification (Reg. 9508 Cap. II Art. 5); a Q_DIAGNOSTIC_TESTING trigger is not added here.
